title.narrative: Korea Trust Fund for Economic and Peacebuilding Transitions

description.narrative: The two main objectives of the proposed trust fund would be: (i) to support measures to improve governance and institutional performance in countries emerging from, or at risk of sliding into crisis or arrears; and (ii) to support the reconstruction and development of countries prone to, in, or emerging from conflict. The objectives of this single-donor trust fund are consistent with the Bank's overall support to fragile and conflict-affected countries, including the multi-donor State and Peace Building Fund (SPF). In agreement with the donor, about 20% of funds may be made available for Regions other than EAP.
